description: This file is a C++ source file implementing a Front Panel control class for a media/stb device, including functionalities for LED control, blinking patterns, preferences management, and associated configurations.

classes.name: CFrontPanel
classes.description: Main class managing front panel LEDs, blinking behaviors, and preferences, utilizing singleton pattern for instance creation.

classes.name: FrontPanelHelper
classes.description: Helper class providing utility functions, such as setting remote LED state.

classes.name: BlinkInfo
classes.description: Structure representing blinking pattern information for LEDs.

methods.name: setBrightness
methods.description: Sets the global LED brightness and updates all indicators.

methods.name: getBrightness
methods.description: Retrieves the current brightness level of the power LED.

methods.name: setClockBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness of the clock display if enabled.

methods.name: getClockBrightness
methods.description: Gets the current brightness level of the clock display if enabled.

methods.name: powerOnLed
methods.description: Turns on specified LED indicators, considering the current power state.

methods.name: remoteLedOn
methods.description: Activates the remote indicator LED, or optionally the power LED if remote is unavailable.

methods.name: setLED
methods.description: Sets the brightness, color, or color mode of a specified LED indicator.

methods.name: setBlink
methods.description: Configures blinking pattern for a specific LED indicator.

methods.name: getPreferences
methods.description: Retrieves the current preferences/settings stored for the front panel.

methods.name: setPreferences
methods.description: Stores preferences/settings to a JSON file.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the front panel management, including indicator states.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops blinking timers and disables front panel indicators.

methods.name: set24HourClock
methods.description: Configures whether the clock display uses 24-hour format.

methods.name: is24HourClock
methods.description: Checks if the clock display is set to 24-hour format.
